milestones.title: Strict Role
milestones.joke: The app's role is locked down.

milestones.title: Wrapped Delivery
milestones.joke: A secret ID only the app can open.
milestones.when: bao: response-wrapped secret ID created and unwrapped once (not wired: needs `bao` events on `sys/wrapping/*`)

milestones.title: Delivered and Deployed
milestones.when: bao: app login with the delivered secret ID (not wired: needs a `bao` event `login`, method approle, role app)

milestones.title: A Branch Gets Nothing
milestones.when: bao: refused delivery from a non-main branch (not wired: needs a `bao` event `login` with error, mount jwt-ci, role deliver-main)
